Name: Olivia as Baphomet from Helltaker (SFW)
Author: HoushovTyler
Description:
# Olivia as Baphomet from Helltaker (SFW)

This Content Patcher mod replaces Olivia from Stardew Valley Expanded with Baphomet from Helltaker with the help of Portraiture.

Features:
- Custom portraits
- Custom sprites
- Seasonal support
- Beach outfit support
- Fully compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded

Requirements:
- SMAPI
-Portraiture
- Content Patcher
- Stardew Valley Expanded

Installation:
1. Install SMAPI
2. Install Content Patcher
3. Install Stardew Valley Expanded
4. Extract this mod into your Stardew Valley Mods folder
5. Launch the game
